criteria.text: Mobile login uses the fixed production cloud origin and fixed rhythmagents callback without native Google client or redirect variables.
The app generates cryptographic app_state and PKCE locally, opens the hosted begin URL, and strictly validates the callback for one in-memory attempt.
The app redeems once over HTTPS without ambiguous POST retry and explains expired or replayed handoffs as begin-fresh-login errors.
Existing session restore remains unchanged and a returned Rhythm session is stored only after a valid redeem response.
Cancellation is actionable without replacing the signed-in session, and account switch or concurrent attempts invalidate stale completion.
Backend broker tests and a cross-stack contract prove the server callback and redeem shapes are consumed by mobile.
Release preflight, app config, EAS production config, signed simulator build, and bundle inspection require no native Google client variables.
No Google, web, or Rhythm token is placed in a deep link or logged; only bounded opaque code and state cross the callback.
Real hosted Google sign-in, exact refreshed-artifact installation, and authenticated-session retention passed; actual environment connection, chat read, and one designated send remain not_tested.
criteria.reason: Manager installed the refreshed artifact over the existing iOS 26.5 app, with installed main.jsbundle parity passing for SHA-256 8ba5de77816121ee668d325a780888541d4bdcb9ac720b0a395997ff4a52867d and candidate executable SHA-256 baaf79ccf656e1975af86d7637741e0e80cdfb8228ed0a1e251eb11673339e9f. Although the Simulator data-container path changed, the app reopened authenticated to Chats without another login, demonstrating that the Google session persisted in SecureStore. The old relay remains healthy and untouched. Matching desktop installation, relay candidate/reconnect, environment discovery, chat read, and one designated send remain not_tested; no desktop lifecycle operation is authorized here.
